snippet.title: Ghost Keeper | 1.0 Out Now!
snippet.description:
We are happy to announce that Ghost Keeper has left Early Access and has entered its full 1.0 version!

👻 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper

Version 1.0 brings the definitive scaring experience: a complete story campaign across 8 unique locations, 9 playable ghosts with tactical abilities, and new challenging enemies like The Destroyer. Lead your supernatural army and claim power through fear!

• Platform: PC (Steam)
• Developer: Quest Craft
